column3: According to the microservices.io page on the API Gateway pattern, the problem is how the clients of a microservices-based application access the individual services.
According to the same page, the solution is an API gateway that is the single entry point for all clients.
The gateway proxies or routes some requests to the appropriate service and handles others by fanning out to multiple services.

The page adds that the gateway can expose a different API for each client, as the Netflix API gateway does with client-specific adapter code, and that it might also implement security, for example by verifying that the client is authorized to perform the request.
